name: Cliopatria (Seshat Global History Databank)
citation: Seshat Global History Databank, Cliopatria v0.2.1 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23128623). Paper: doi:10.1038/s41597-025-04516-9. Polity extents are scholarly approximations. Geometry simplified for display.

name: Author-compiled approximate sites (unverified)
citation: Approximate site locations and age windows compiled from general knowledge (AI-assisted), partly cross-checked against PBDB, Wikidata and Wikipedia. Not verified against primary sources; replaced as sourced data (e.g. ROAD, PBDB) lands.

name: Wikidata
citation: Short descriptions and identifiers from Wikidata.

name: Wikidata coordinates and Wikipedia dates
citation: Site coordinates from Wikidata (P625, CC0); age ranges as stated in English Wikipedia articles. Each site records its Wikidata item and the exact Wikipedia page revision used.
